result.summary: Deployment-preparation package built, verified and pushed (9cedda7 on origin/main). Created deployments/ with an 11-part pack: full deployment manifest (host/runtime/state/services/ports, laptop-primary and VPS-primary variants with every topology-specific step marked PENDING OWNER DECISION), access/account checklist (all credentials by store name and env-var name only, zero values), an ordered owner-action TODO, dependency/runtime inventory, backup-restore plan, service definitions with re-importable Task Scheduler XML exports for all 8 Chief tasks, cutover runbook, rollback + no-go checklist, and acceptance/health commands. Added four read-only executable verifiers: deployment_inventory.py, deployment_preflight.py (go/no-go, exit code driven), deployment_backup_restore_drill.py (SQLite-consistent snapshots, integrity + fingerprint verification, restore into a throwaway dir, deployment rollback dry-run), and set_provider_key.py (owner-run, getpass no-echo credential storage so no key ever reaches shell history/logs/chat/GitHub). Real verification on this machine: preflight verdict GO with 0 failures and 1 owner-gated warning; backup/restore drill PASS on 10/10 artifacts with rollback dry-run clean; regression 16/16 suites, 456/456 tests, 0 failed/errors/skipped at SHA b6329b7; E4/E5 drills 33/33 with real_provider_calls=0; eb e3-verify-db PASSED (schema v2). New findings recorded but deliberately NOT changed: 7 of 8 Chief tasks set DisallowStartIfOnBatteries/StopIfGoingOnBatteries=true so they will not run on battery (gateway only exempt); no log rotation/retention configured; no off-site backup; every Chief task is interactive-token only so no unattended topology is possible without an owner-approved service account; no inbound network exposure is required (outbound 443 only). No architecture was finalised, no VPS login, no secrets handled, no service/task/state changed, no reboot. The standing 7/7 missing provider credentials remain the only blocking owner dependency.
